summary: Colliers International Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing a press release announcing its first quarter 2026 financial results. The report details revenues of $1.31 billion, net revenues of $1.15 billion, Adjusted EBITDA of $124.8 million, and Adjusted EPS of $0.91 for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing also mentions a pending acquisition of Ayesa Engineering expected to close later in the quarter and a $400 million long-term debt financing. This is a routine periodic earnings report, not a special situation filing.
